title: 00975 - P261A/009754
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
symptoms: Fault code stored in memory, no check engine light
"In certain North American vehicles with a 2.0L TFSI gasoline engine, the electric (after run) coolant pump may short circuit and/or overheat, potentially leading to a vehicle fire"
commonCauses:
Coolant pump is disconnected
If Recall/Service Action 19N4 was completed, the coolant pump will be disconnected and no fault code will be present.
If the above is true, then the vehicle should have an open Campaign for the 19N8 Service action
